column2: Why did Xiamen University (XMU) establish a campus in Malaysia?
column3: Xiamen University (XMU) established a campus in Malaysia as a historic reciprocation, 93 years after its founding, in the country where its founder Mr. Tan Kah Kee achieved great success in his career.

column2: What spirit does Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM) pledge to uphold?
column3: Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM) solemnly pledges to uphold Mr. Tan Kah Kee’s spirit of selfless dedication to the noble causes of education.

column2: What is the financial model of Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM)?
column3: Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM) will remain a not-for-profit institution, with no funds repatriated to China. Any surplus funds will be channelled back into research and scholarships for its students.

column2: What does the establishment of Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM) signify for China-Malaysia relations?
column3: The establishment of Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM) sets new heights in the areas of cooperation and exchange in education between China and Malaysia.

column2: What is Xiamen University (XMU)'s goal for its Malaysia campus?
column3: Xiamen University (XMU) is driven to build its Malaysia campus into one of Malaysia's best, enriching Malaysia's tertiary education landscape and producing high-quality talents with international competitiveness.

column2: What is the vision of Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM)?
column3: The vision of Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM) is to become a university with a distinct global outlook, featuring first-class teaching and research, and embracing cultural diversity.

column2: What is the mission of Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM)?
column3: The mission of Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM) is to nurture young talents with dignity and wisdom, turning them into fine citizens of the region who will contribute to the prosperity of the people and social progress of Malaysia, China and Southeast Asia.
